intro.sr: Administrator piše i objavljuje novi blog post - naslov, kratak opis, telo teksta kroz editor sastavljen od blokova, i obavezna naslovna slika.
intro.en: The admin writes and publishes a new blog post - a title, a short excerpt, body text through a block-based editor, and a required cover image.

admin-prijava.sr: Administrator se prijavljuje na svoj nalog.
admin-prijava.en: The admin logs into their account.

admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.sr: Administrator na telefonu otvara glavni meni dugmetom sa tri crtice.
admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.en: On a phone the admin opens the main menu with the three-line button.

admin-ulazak-otvara-admin-panel.en: In the “Admin” section they tap “Admin panel”.

admin-blog-otvara-meni.sr: Admin panel ima sopstveni meni iza dugmeta sa tri crtice. Otvaramo ga i biramo grupu „Sadržaj i marketing“.
admin-blog-otvara-meni.en: The admin panel has its own menu behind a three-line button. We open it and choose the “Sadržaj i marketing” group.

admin-blog-bira-stavku.en: The admin taps "Blog" in the menu.

unos-naslova-i-opisa.sr: Administrator unosi naslov i kratak opis koji se prikazuje u pregledu.
unos-naslova-i-opisa.en: The admin enters the title and a short excerpt shown in previews.

dodavanje-pasusa.sr: Administrator dodaje blok teksta - editor je sastavljen od blokova, svaki tip ima svoja polja.
dodavanje-pasusa.en: The admin adds a text block - the editor is block-based, each type has its own fields.

izbor-statusa.sr: Administrator bira „Objavljeno” - post odmah postaje javno vidljiv.
izbor-statusa.en: The admin selects "Published" - the post becomes publicly visible immediately.

otpremanje-naslovne-slike.sr: Naslovna slika je obavezna - administrator je otprema i unosi alt tekst.
otpremanje-naslovne-slike.en: A cover image is required - the admin uploads one and enters alt text.

cuvanje-posta.sr: Administrator čuva post - odmah je dostupan na javnom blogu.
cuvanje-posta.en: The admin saves the post - it's immediately available on the public blog.
